behavior.on_interrupt: Save checkpoint to state.db with counters, todo snapshot, pending tools, message snapshot.
behavior.on_next_message: Gateway detects checkpoint, prompts user, decides resume/ignore, passes decision to run_conversation.
behavior.on_resume: turn_context restores counters/todo, injects resume note + pending tool_calls assistant message, persists resumed messages.
behavior.on_completion: conversation_loop deletes checkpoint so it is not reloaded.

future_improvements: Synchronous user confirmation instead of heuristic (requires gateway clarify integration).
Persist file-level checksums or operation log for idempotent file work.
Compress old checkpoints and keep longer history.
